def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    vals = sorted(set(a))
    idx = {v: i + 1 for i, v in enumerate(vals)}
    m = len(vals)
    r = [idx[v] for v in a]
    tree = [0] * (m + 1)
    res = [0] * n
    size = 0
    for i in range(n):
        ri = r[i]
        # count elements <= a[i] in window
        s = 0
        j = ri
        while j > 0:
            s += tree[j]
            j &= j - 1
        res[i] = size - s
        # add a[i]
        j = ri
        while j <= m:
            tree[j] += 1
            j += j & (-j)
        size += 1
        # remove a[i-k]
        if i - k >= 0:
            j = r[i - k]
            while j <= m:
                tree[j] -= 1
                j += j & (-j)
            size -= 1
    return res
